Adopt the AI's drafts into the study's report files

Source: R/ai_adopt.R
tfl_ai_adopt.Rd

The AI drafts a study's report files apart from the study's own (in a study with ai/spec/outputs/, tfl_ai_migrate()): every collection (tfl_ai_collect_answers(), run.R) writes the drafts there and builds them into ai/output/. A draft the person finds finished is adopted: copied to spec/outputs/, where the study's lists, programs and runs read it, and the AI never writes over it. Adopting again after the AI redrafted a report replaces the adopted file only with overwrite = TRUE – a person may have changed it since.

Usage

tfl_ai_adopt(study_dir, outputs = NULL, overwrite = FALSE, dry_run = FALSE)

Arguments

study_dir

The study folder.

outputs

The reports to adopt (their ids); NULL, every draft.

overwrite

TRUE to write over a report already adopted (or written by hand) that differs from its draft. A report adopted that the study's spec/toc.yml does not list (a part the AI wrote, a report it named otherwise) gets an entry there – after its number's, else at the end – so the study's report list shows it.

dry_run

TRUE to copy nothing and say what adopting would do: status new (no study file yet), replace (the study's file differs from the draft: adopting writes over it, with overwrite = TRUE), same, no draft – for a screen's question before it adopts.

Value

A data frame, one row a report: output_id, status (adopted, same – the study's file is the draft already –, kept – the study's file differs and was left, pass overwrite = TRUE –, no draft), file (the study's file), toc (added: its entry was added to spec/toc.yml; with dry_run, add). The adoptions are recorded in ai/adopted.csv (the report, when, the draft's md5).

See also

tfl_ai_migrate(), tfl_ai_collect_answers()
